summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc., a Canadian mining company, filed a Form 6-K with an attached news release dated August 31, 2026, announcing the publication of its Fiscal 2026 Sustainability Report. The report details ESG commitments, performance, and targets for the year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting reductions in water intensity, increased environmental and community investments, and governance enhancements. This is a routine disclosure of a sustainability report, not a special-situation transaction. No financial terms, deals, or strategic corporate actions are involved; it is purely informational and non-transactional.
